name: appkit
description: The zinc:ui tree shown with real AppKit views under "ui": {"render": "native"} (macOS): View, Text, Image, ScrollView, TextInput, TextArea and Pressable as NSViews, measured by AppKit, in the system colours; Window, Toolbar, SplitView and Sidebar as the window's own chrome; Table and Outline as NSTableView and NSOutlineView; the controls (push button, switch, check box, pop-up, segmented control, slider, date picker, search field, progress bar, and the kits' mapped to them) and alerts, sheets and popovers
